svg.title: Vocabloom security layers
svg.desc: A conversion request passes eight checks in order before the AI is paid for. Around it sit protections in the browser, on the server and in how data is kept.
svg.text: A request stops at the first check that says no, and the AI is only paid for once all of them pass.
Wrong codes: 5 per 15 minutes per client, and a client over the limit gets no more guesses, not even a correct one. Defaults shown.
